scenario.title: Carrier rejects shipment notices
scenario.initial_request: Let an AI agent auto-fix rejected shipment notices and resubmit them

CL-01.statement: Let an AI agent auto-fix rejected shipment notices and resubmit them

CL-02.statement: The carrier system is flaky; just resubmit everything.

H-REQUESTER-FRAMING-AUTO-FIX.statement: Rejected notices are due to correctable errors that an AI agent can fix and resubmit.

H-DATA-FORMAT-ERRORS.statement: Rejects result from malformed or missing fields in shipment notices that violate carrier schema.

H-CARRIER-RULE-CHANGE.statement: Carrier recently updated validation rules, causing previously valid notices to be rejected.

H-HANDOFF-LATENCY.statement: Delayed or incomplete handoff from shipper to carrier leads to partial notices being rejected.

interpretation_history.interpretation: The reject log shows two notices rejected for missing location (LOC_UNKNOWN) and one for event ordering (EVENT_ORDER). This indicates data quality issues rather than rule changes.

E-02.content: The carrier system is flaky; just resubmit everything.

interpretation_history.interpretation: The stakeholder indicates the carrier system is flaky and recommends resubmitting all notices, suggesting transient issues rather than persistent data errors.

U-REJECT-LOG-COMPLETENESS-UNKN.question: Is the reject log complete and accurate for measuring symptom frequency?
U-REJECT-LOG-COMPLETENESS-UNKN.resolution_path: Perform a periodic audit by cross‑checking reject‑log entries with carrier acknowledgments or shipment‑notice IDs
U-REJECT-LOG-COMPLETENESS-UNKN.safe_placeholder: Treat observed reject counts as a lower bound and continue manual review of rejected notices

U-FIX-SUFFICIENCY.question: Will fixing location and event‑order fields eliminate all rejections, or are there other hidden causes?
U-FIX-SUFFICIENCY.resolution_path: Run a controlled pilot where location and event fields are corrected on a subset of notices and measure the resulting rejection rate
U-FIX-SUFFICIENCY.safe_placeholder: Limit auto‑fix to notices with high‑confidence field corrections and require a Human Gate for the remainder

U-CARRIER-FLAKINESS-IMPACT.question: Does transient carrier flakiness contribute a non‑trivial share of rejections that would persist after data fixes?
U-CARRIER-FLAKINESS-IMPACT.resolution_path: Track the success rate of automatic resubmits; compare to baseline to quantify the flakiness component
U-CARRIER-FLAKINESS-IMPACT.safe_placeholder: Cap automatic resubmit attempts at two per notice and require a Human Gate thereafter

A-REJECT-LOG-COMPLETENESS.statement: The carrier reject log (DA-REJ) completely captures all rejected notices

A-REJECTION-CAUSE.statement: LOC_UNKNOWN and EVENT_ORDER rejections are due to missing/malformed fields rather than carrier rule changes

A-FIX-EFFECTIVENESS.statement: Correcting location and event ordering fields will prevent the corresponding rejections

SC-ZERO-LOCATION-EVENT-REJECTS.statement: Zero rejected notices due to LOC_UNKNOWN or EVENT_ORDER errors
SC-ZERO-LOCATION-EVENT-REJECTS.validation_method: Verify that the reject log shows zero LOC_UNKNOWN and EVENT_ORDER entries after the fix is applied

problem_definition.requested_solution: Let an AI agent auto-fix rejected shipment notices and resubmit them
problem_definition.root_problem: Missing location (LOC_UNKNOWN) and incorrect event ordering (EVENT_ORDER) fields in shipment notices cause carrier rejections.

details.requested_solution: Let an AI agent auto-fix rejected shipment notices and resubmit them

structural_remedies.description: Add mandatory pre-submission validation at the shipper (ORG-A) to check for presence and correctness of location and event-order fields before generating shipment notices (E-01, A-REJECTION-CAUSE).
structural_remedies.rationale: Can be configured via form/rules update within the remaining 150 minutes.; residual gap: Potential other data quality issues beyond location/event order remain unknown (U-FIX-SUFFICIENCY).

structural_remedies.description: Assign data quality ownership to the shipper with an SLA requiring zero LOC_UNKNOWN and EVENT_ORDER rejects, monitored via the carrier reject log (E-01).
structural_remedies.rationale: Organizational agreement can be drafted quickly; no tool changes needed.; residual gap: Potential other data quality issues beyond location/event order remain unknown (U-FIX-SUFFICIENCY).

structural_remedies.description: Insert a schema validation step in the handoff (H-1) that blocks notices missing location or incorrect event order from reaching the carrier (E-01).
structural_remedies.rationale: A lightweight validation tool can be deployed within the remaining time.; residual gap: Potential other data quality issues beyond location/event order remain unknown (U-FIX-SUFFICIENCY).

work_items.description: Query the carrier reject log to list rejected notices and reasons.
Validate shipment notices against carrier schema using reject log as reference.
Resubmit corrected notices to the carrier after fixing location and event-order fields.

current_plan.rationale: The release scope specifies inspect_reject_log, validate_shipment_notice, and resubmit_notice as core steps to eliminate LOC_UNKNOWN and EVENT_ORDER rejects. Evidence E-01 shows three rejects (2 LOC_UNKNOWN, 1 EVENT_ORDER) confirming the need for these actions (PD-1). No mutating tools are defined, so no protected actions are required at this stage. Side effects are limited to read-only queries; resubmit would transmit notices if a mutating tool existed. Reads are reversible; resubmit is not. Alternatives include bypassing validation or delaying resubmission until data-fix sufficiency is verified. (R-10)

framing_assertion.rationale: The initial request assumes that rejected shipment notices can be auto-fixed and resubmitted by an AI agent.

hypotheses.statement: Rejected notices are due to correctable errors that an AI agent can fix and resubmit.
hypotheses.rationale: If true, an automated fix-and-resubmit solution would resolve the problem; if false, a different approach is needed.

hypotheses.statement: Rejects result from malformed or missing fields in shipment notices that violate carrier schema.
hypotheses.rationale: If true, fixing data quality at source or enhancing validation would be required; auto-fix may still work if errors are simple.

hypotheses.statement: Carrier recently updated validation rules, causing previously valid notices to be rejected.
hypotheses.rationale: If true, solution must track rule versions and adapt mappings; auto-fix would need rule awareness.

hypotheses.statement: Delayed or incomplete handoff from shipper to carrier leads to partial notices being rejected.
hypotheses.rationale: If true, improving handoff timeliness or completeness would reduce rejects; auto-fix of partial data may be insufficient.
